reason: A database-changing action is being proposed without the required explicit user confirmation right before the tool call. The assistant already asked for confirmation earlier and received yes, but then used tools to gather options and changed the shipping address. Now it is proposing `modify_pending_order_items`, which the policy says can only be done once per order and requires that all item changes be collected before the tool call. However, the visible prefix also shows the assistant has already gathered both item IDs, so the main issue is that the last assistant message is a tool call immediately after stating an action was confirmed, which appears compliant on confirmation but risky because the item-modification call may violate the “all items collected before making the tool call” constraint only if the selected items are incomplete. Based on visible evidence, there is at least a substantial policy risk around the one-time pending-order item modification and action sequencing.
